description: SS 32(i) denial driven by the NEW standalone shortTermCapitalGains/ordinaryDividends facts. MFJ, wages 28,921, taxableInterest 0, shortTermCapitalGains 14,000, longTermCapitalGains 4,800, ordinaryDividends 301, 1 qualifying child. Investment income = 0 + 4,800 + 0 (qualifiedDividends) + 14,000 + 301 = 19,101, which exceeds the TY2025 MFJ SS 32(i) limit of $11,950 -> EIC = $0 even though earned income (28,921) and AGI are well inside the credit's phase-in/phase-out range. Before this fix, shortTermCapitalGains/ordinaryDividends were invisible to the SS 32(i) test and this return would have wrongly received a credit.
